content.value: The single-phase dual converter is operated from 120V, 60 Hz supply and load resistance is $\mathtt { R } = 1 0 \Omega$ The circulating inductance is $\mathrm { L } _ { \mathrm { r } } = 4$ mH; delay angles are $\alpha _ { 1 } = 6 0 ^ { \circ }$ and $\alpha _ { 2 } =$ 120°.
